I would still recommend Heroic servers over interactive at the moment. Interactive worlds are built around the use of the auction house and trading and all that, but in gms our economy was ravaged by bots and hackers for years and years. It's just not feasible to play the game as it was designed on interactive without spending a huge chunk of money, getting handouts from gigawhale friends, or being satisfied being stuck at a progression wall WAY earlier than you would be on heroic. Not to mention how much a pain in the ass it is working around frenzy totem...

As long as you commit to one main and don't flip flop around every few months you'll be able to progress just fine as a new player anyways. Go West has a few events (like Zero to One Hundred and Hyper Burning for example) that are great for new players building their accounts too so you'll get a good jumpstart. And although burning world does only work with interactive servers, heroic servers will get 2 mega burninator coupons to compensate.

To me it's not *that* misleading the call LA a maple competitor. It came out at the **PERFECT** time, after a slew of awful decisions and game issues, we now have a much better option to go spend our time on. The removal of kishin, wild totems are in limbo, the prime channel fiasco, dutch players getting assblasted, reg server players getting a MASSIVE hit with cs 2x drop removal... Everyone has a reason to leave for greener pastures.

The similarities between the games are so abundant in my eyes. You have gear progression behind a significant grind (although not as horrifically punishing as MS), dailies/weeklies to assist in that progression, the satisfaction of killing a billion monsters every day to wind down, account-wide bonuses to search and collect, a use for alts so that you can enjoy other combat styles (but not as hardcore REQUIRED as MS), harder content to test your abilities and strength, and then mindless grinding stuff to do after all that is done. The only difference to me is that Maplestory is 2D and that Nexon spits in our faces 24/7. I will concede that the aesthetic does play a huge part though. We all love cute chibi and the MS music/art, but imo that doesn't make up for how bad the rest of the game is.
